confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Boston pricing in peak July season. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are the more reliable; accommodation is least certain and reflects typical summer rates including Massachusetts room tax. Cocktail and wine are not directly known, so they are set from the local beer relationship: cocktail about 1.9x beer and wine glass about 1.7x beer. Nothing here comes from live listings or menus.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other large, tourism-heavy northeastern US cities with similar restaurant and hotel pricing, such as Philadelphia and Washington, DC, adjusted for Boston's typically high summer hotel rates.
